clauses.scope_note: Applies to the software. Use, copying, modification, distribution, and making it available to a third party are barred unless the copyright owner gives express written permission. Translation is also expressly restricted, but is not an allowed activity to report here.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when express written permission from the copyright owner has not been given.

coverage_notes: The text says use is subject to a separate license agreement, but that agreement is not supplied; its terms and any permissions or additional conditions cannot be determined here.

The no-implied-rights statement does not establish permissions for activities not addressed by an operative clause. Warranty and liability disclaimers are omitted as unrelated to the requested activities.
